fields.v: No SDD approach. Context construction methods for repository-level code generation, reproduced in a common pipeline: 11 functionality-oriented (InCoder-FIM, LongCoder-Mem, ReACC-Hybrid, CCEval-BM25, RepoBench-R, ProCC-Multi, RepoCoder-Iter, RLPG-Proposal, DevEval-Dep, SWE-agent-Ret, ClaudeCode-Ret), 2 security-aware (CodeGuarder; Source-sink slicing, authors' own probe), 6 controls (Local-only, BM25+README, Repo-128K, Security reminder, Placebo, Reference context). End-to-end agents: SWE-agent (Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.4), Claude Code (Sonnet 4.5). Versions of agents not stated

Oracle validated on vulnerable/patched/alternative/deny-all versions; manual audit 95.7%/kappa 0.90

Success criterion: SecPass@1 (tests pass, PoC blocked); 3 runs/task; values pooled over 6 models (GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, gpt-oss-120b); per-model values not reported in text. Fun% / Sec% / CbE%: Local-only 56.9/12.6/44.3 (baseline); BM25+README 59.7/12.4/47.3; Security reminder 55.1/13.9/41.2; Placebo 56.2/12.9/43.3; Repo-128K 60.9/12.1/48.8; InCoder-FIM 57.4/12.8/44.6; LongCoder-Mem 57.8/13.2/44.6; ReACC-Hybrid 61.9/15.4/46.5; CCEval-BM25 60.3/11.5/48.8; RepoBench-R 52.1/11.8/40.3; ProCC-Multi 65.1/14.9/50.2; RepoCoder-Iter 55.0/12.9/42.1; RLPG-Proposal 54.6/12.3/42.3; DevEval-Dep 56.4/13.3/43.1; SWE-agent-Ret 55.0/11.7/43.3; ClaudeCode-Ret 63.8/16.3/47.5; CodeGuarder 58.8/16.8/42.0; Source-sink 61.2/18.1/43.1; Reference context (diagnostic) 62.3/24.8/37.5. Quality verdict: does not work for security in all (SecPass@1 <= 25%), partly for Source-sink/CodeGuarder/Reference. Cost verdict for these 19 conditions: not assessable; only mean context tokens beyond the target file are reported (Table 2: 0 for Local-only, 2.7K-7.9K under the 8K cap, 118K for Repo-128K), no money or time per method. Agents (Table 6): SWE-agent + Sonnet 4.5: 69.7/16.6/53.1, USD 1.08; SWE-agent + GPT-5.4: 71.0/16.1/54.9, USD 0.91; Claude Code (version n.s.) + Sonnet 4.5: 74.0/18.4/55.6, USD 1.41 (functional partly works, security does not; cost higher than retrieval). fields.v: Tasks: 145 CASE-Bench tasks. Configurations: 13 methods + 6 controls x 6 LLMs (RQ1); single-element context edits with matched controls on 3 models (RQ2); 3 agent configurations vs best retrieval method with same backbone (RQ3). Baseline: Local-only. Held constant: task, prompt skeleton, oracle, 8K retrieval cap, model defaults (temp 0.2 for non-reasoning). Acceptance: expert functional tests + PoC exploit. Repetitions: 3 runs per task. Human intervention: none. Stats: cluster bootstrap, logistic mixed-effects, 18 pre-specified comparisons with Holm, 3 pp relevance threshold

Functionality-oriented methods change FuncPass@1 by -4.8 to +8.2 pp but SecPass@1 by -1.1 to +3.7 pp; none significant vs Local-only (ClaudeCode-Ret OR 1.35, pHolm=.19). Source-sink +5.5 pp (significant, pHolm=.006), CodeGuarder +4.2 pp (pHolm=.07); Reference context +12.2 pp. Agents raise FuncPass@1 by 2.7-7.1 pp over best retrieval but SecPass@1 only -1.3 to +0.5 pp; observe safeguard in 27-36% of trajectories. Static vs PoC oracles rank methods only moderately alike (tau 0.56)

Distinguished security-aware from functionality-oriented contexts and showed oracle choice changes rankings; power 80% only for >= 5.6 pp, so smaller effects undetected. Robustness checks (native budgets tau 0.89, mutated tasks, reweighting) preserved rankings. Limitations: reproduced (not original) context policies; agent analysis observational; PoC cannot exclude vulnerabilities

Construct: SecPass@1 relative to tests and exploits (variants change 7.3% of verdicts); heuristic failure labels; single static query configuration. Internal: reproduced policies may deviate from originals; agent analysis observational; contamination not ruled out. External: 51 projects, 6 contribute 67 tasks; weakness type and language confounded; differences < ~5.6 pp undetected. Future: safeguard-type-aware retrieval; CASE-Bench as testbed; feature-level multi-file tasks
